items.text: Eagles will play first game Sunday without Jalen Hurts (calf/blood clot); Tanner McKee starts.
items.implication: McKee QB; top pass-catchers healthy per Levitan.
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks elevated in McKee offense.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) Week 6 vs NE; third straight miss, AD Mitchell also OUT.
Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers due to hamstring. Will Shipley also placed on IR.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week, second straight miss.
items.implication: Lead back role opens; Tanner McKee starting at QB.
items.opportunity: Volume to remaining RBs vs soft CAR run D.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to ankle injury; second straight miss, Tyler Huntley starts.
items.implication: Huntley under center again; pass game downgrade.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers still viable WR2; Andrews downgrade.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition as questionable; occurred in individual drills.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other IND pass catchers up.

items.text: Unclear on AJ Brown (ankle) questionable; practiced limited all week earlier than expected. Henderson (ankle) also unclear Q.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice but high-ankle concern for Henderson, NE plays TNF next.
items.implication: Monitor Saturday; possible return for Brown.
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to other NE WRs/RBs.

items.text: Caleb Williams Q after full practices seems more like probable; similar for Metcalf, Olave, Dowdle.
items.implication: Likely active; Bears offense upgrade vs ATL.

items.text: Ladd McConkey IN (no designation) along with Quentin Johnston; cleared for Chargers at KC.
DeVonta Smith IN; removed from report, returns with top-4 PHI pass-catchers healthy for McKee.
items.implication: Borderline WR2 with McKee; Goedert/Wicks also up.
items.opportunity: Targets in pass-heavy script without Hurts/Barkley.

items.text: CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix IN/cleared; MHJ noted with Texans?
items.opportunity: Lamb WR1, Jeanty RB starter, Penix QB upgrade for ATL.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders D nightmare for WRs, soft matchup.
items.why: Washington secondary buffet for pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Elite target share vs weak D.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI); usage + soft matchups.
items.why: Bankable usage; WSH D soft for TE, ARI leaky vs RB, London role.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI); ugly matchups + shaky QB/feed.
items.why: SEA tough for Waddle; low feed/struggles for others.

items.text: HATE Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @KC); also loves Javonte/Rhamondre, hates Dobbins. LOVES Purdy/Stafford/Love QBs.
items.why: Tough D for Nix, low totals for Herbert; volume/matchups for loved RBs/QBs.
items.opportunity: Kyren/Javonte/Rhamondre volume vs leaky run Ds.
